messages.subject: setting map creation options from R  via shiny and leaflet
parts:
I am using shiny and leaflet from R to display a map. I would like to set worldCopyJump = TRUE when the map is created, but I don't see how to do this, any advice much appreciated. The leaflet API doesn't seem to have a function to change this option after map creation, so I think it needs to be done when the map is created.



Here's a brief sketch of how I am currently using shiny/eaflet (I can post the complete code if that would be helpful):



    shinyUI(
    //// stuff...
        leafletOutput("mymap")
    //// stuff...
    )


    shinyServer(function(input, output) {

    output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({

               leaflet() %>%      
                  addTiles() %>%
                  //// stuff...
         })
    })
